name: cockpit
description: Claude Code status line plugin: context %, session cost, budget, context and rate-limit alerts, /cockpit dashboard with rate limits, burn rate and MCP health, and an rm -rf guard for Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive and your own protected folders.

budget.title: Cost alert (USD)
budget.description: Show one pop-up when the session's cost reaches this many US dollars (the dashboard's cost turns red too); 0 turns it off

contextAlert.title: Context alert (%)
contextAlert.description: Show one pop-up when the context window reaches this percent full, again after a /compact brings it back under; 0 turns it off

rateAlert.title: Rate-limit alert (%)
rateAlert.description: Show one pop-up per rate-limit window (such as the 5-hour limit) when it reaches this percent used, with its reset time; 0 turns it off

guardPaths.title: Protected folders
guardPaths.description: Extra folders where recursive deletes are blocked, split by ';' (e.g. ~/work; /Volumes/NAS). The guard treats them like synced folders but does not warn about installs there

desktopSync.title: Guard ~/Desktop and ~/Documents
desktopSync.description: Treat ~/Desktop and ~/Documents as cloud-synced folders. Turn on if macOS iCloud Drive 'Desktop & Documents Folders' (or OneDrive folder backup) syncs them

compactTools.title: Compact read-only tool rows
compactTools.description: Shrink the rows of finished Read calls (and Glob/Grep, on builds that have them) to one dim line

projectTags.title: Project tags
projectTags.description: Optional labels for projects, as needle=Label pairs split by ';' (e.g. acme=Acme Corp; client-x=Client X). A project whose full path contains a needle (any letter case) shows its label in the status line, pane and spinner
